ns2:section.sectionText: FOR HERITAGE SPEAKERS "Online/hours arranged" Online section designed for Spanish/English bilingual students who grew up speaking/hearing Spanish at home and wish to develop their academic skills in Spanish. A few group sessions and individual meetings will be arranged with the instructor. This class typically meets 2 hours per week in class. For Fall 2020 these meetings will take place via Zoom. Additional weekly online assignments will also be required. Non registered students are not allowed to sit-in or audit.
